note: Cases built from traits/trait_validator.rs: the trait-typed config default check (ORB_BINDING_TRAIT_INVALID_FORMAT), the unbound trait knob embed check over `@config.<knob>` and over `trait`/`behavior`-typed entity fields (ORB_RENDER_UNBOUND_TRAIT_KNOB_EMBEDDED) and the orbital-typed field embed check (ORB_RENDER_ORBITAL_VALUE_EMBEDDED). The first, second, third and fourth cases are .orb programs whose expected findings are the ones the core checks report (`program/validate`). The last case has no Rust file counterpart: the inline phase substitutes a `none` knob before validation, so a file never reaches the knob check with `@config.<knob>` intact; its expectation is the Rust check applied to the trait as the Rust unit tests build it (guarded then-branches exempt only their own knob, the else branch and a condition on another binding stay checked, an in-payload `if`/`when` condition is never an embed, strings below an object are checked only inside a render-ui, an object-wrapped render-ui is not walked).
